messages:
Priya M: Follow-up from metering postmortem: we saw delayed ingestion + token mismatches affecting invoices. Need owners, ETA, and a short playbook for credits.

Cheng W: I'll build a signed delta export that shows raw vs ingested tokens per customer. ETA Thu. Will include max_delay_secs and a GUID for audit.

Sam R: I'll own the aggregator that surfaces events where ingest_delay > 1h or token delta > 1%. ETA Fri EOD. I'll wire alerts into PagerDuty.

Alex J: Priya to draft the invoice-hold/runbook and comms template. Legal needs to confirm timeframe for notice/credits. Priya, can you target Tue next week?

Priya M: Yep. Drafting support/email copy now. Suggest 7 business days for reconciliation; pinging Legal.

Cheng W: SQL prototype (short):
SELECT customer_id, SUM(raw_tokens) raw, SUM(bill_tokens) ingested, SUM(raw_tokens)-SUM(bill_tokens) delta, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(bill_ts)-MAX(event_ts)) delay_secs FROM raw_usage LEFT JOIN billing_ingest USING(event_id) GROUP BY customer_id HAVING delta != 0 OR delay_secs > 3600;

Sam R: Note: some legacy events lack event_id. Fallback will be windowed matching by user+time. Also propose thresholds: auto-hold if projected delta > $100 OR >3% monthly spend.

Alex J: Good. Add a GDPR flag to avoid exporting PII. Cheng add signed CSV; Finance will ingest to ledger. Priya add reason_code "metering-delay-credit" to support tickets.

BillingBot: [automated] Issue MET-4301 created: "metering delayed-ingest audit" assigned Sam R.

Priya M: Legal replied: 7 business days OK for customer notice; credits to appear next invoice if processed by finance.

Alex J: Ownership summary: Sam R - aggregator + alerts + CLI to generate credits CSV; Cheng W - compute script + signed export + Grafana panel; Priya M - invoice-hold flow, comms, support automation; Alex J - PM lead. Timeline: Cheng Thu, Sam Fri, Priya Tue.

Sam R: Will open PR for aggregator and link to the sheet.

Cheng W: Will post signed export sample in spreadsheet.

Priya M: Uploaded draft email. Please review.

Alex J: Quick sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to confirm legal sign-off and PR status. If blocker, escalate to finance lead for manual holds.

BillingBot: [automated] MET-4301 status: in_progress -> review (Sam R).
